description: IHC4 Score 計算配置檔案
reference: Dowsett et al. Prediction of endocrine therapy benefit from ER and HER2 status in breast cancer. J Natl Cancer Inst. 2010;102(21):1618-1632.

normalization.description: 標準化方法 - 將 H-score 或 IHC 轉換為 0-1 範圍

coefficients.description: 邏輯迴歸係數（基於 Dowsett et al. 2010）
coefficients._calculation_note: IHC4 = intercept + (ER_coef * ER_normalized) + (PR_coef * PR_normalized) + (HER2_coef * HER2_normalized) + (Ki67_coef * Ki67_log10)

subtype_classification.description: 根據 St Gallen 2021 標準的亞型分類

luminal_a.criteria: ER+ or PR+, HER2-, Ki67 low (<13.25%)

luminal_b_her2_negative.criteria: ER+, HER2-, Ki67 high (≥13.25%) OR PR-

low_risk.description: 低風險，預後良好，適合激素治療

intermediate_risk.description: 中風險，預後中等，可考慮化療

high_risk.description: 高風險，預後不良，建議化療

predict_score.description: Predict Score 計算（用於估計內分泌治療獲益）
predict_score.note: 基於 IHC4 加上臨床因素的調整
